research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Multi-hour special examining new evidence and forensic analysis in Routier case; more detailed than previous coverage. Available via NBC/Peacock.
research_notes_other.research_findings: While a specific Dateline episode with this exact title wasn't confirmed, the description points to a deeper investigation into the Routier case. The most significant update is the ongoing, court-ordered DNA testing on key pieces of evidence, the results of which are still pending after several years. A 2015 book, "Dateline Purgatory," also examined the case controversies.

contributing_factors_raw: Focus on re-analysis of disputed forensic evidence (blood spatter, fingerprint, sock), potential alternative suspects.
featured_individuals.status_raw: On death row; results of multiple rounds of court-ordered DNA testing (since 2018) are still pending
organizations_involved_raw: Legal teams pursuing appeals and DNA testing.
